question: Which kathak dancer was awarded with Padma Shri and Sangeet Natak Akademi Award?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sitara Devi.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Sitara Devi** was a **renowned Kathak dancer** who was awarded **Padma Shri in 1969 **and** Sangeet Natak Akademi Award** in **1973** for her contribution to Indian classical dance.</li&g
